title: HRFlow AI
shortDesc: Automated resume parsing, candidate scoring, and interview scheduling pipeline.
problem: Recruiters spend 25+ hours per week manually reviewing unstructured PDF resumes and coordinating screening calls.
whatWeBuilt: Built an automated resume parsing pipeline that extracts candidate skills, scores relevance against job descriptions, and dispatches automated interview booking links.
honestScopeNote: Built under a 3-week sprint. UX audit identified 18 friction points; initial release prioritized automated candidate resume filtering over custom enterprise ATS sync.
